topics: 让手机在学校里拿不到
title: Phones out of reach at school
titleZh: 让手机在学校里拿不到
summaryZh: 英格兰的新指导计划不仅要求手机不发出声音，也强调全天不可取用；限制个人手机与提高教育技术安全性是两条不同路线。

sentences.text: On 10 November 2026, England’s Department for Education announced plans to strengthen its guidance on mobile phones in schools.
sentences.zh: 2026年11月10日，英格兰教育部宣布计划加强学校手机使用指导。

sentences.text: The aim is to give pupils a school day with fewer distractions and more time to learn and connect with other people.
sentences.zh: 其目的是让学生在校期间少受干扰，有更多时间学习并与他人交流。

sentences.text: Many schools already have a rule that phones must not be seen or heard, but this can still leave them in pupils’ bags.
sentences.zh: 许多学校已有规定，手机不能被看见或发出声音，但手机仍可能留在学生的书包里。

sentences.text: The strengthened guidance will ask schools to go further: phones should be out of use and out of reach throughout the school day.
sentences.zh: 加强后的指导将要求学校更进一步：整个在校日内，手机应不能使用，也不能取用。

sentences.text: This means a clear approach across the whole school, rather than simply asking pupils to keep their devices quiet during lessons.
sentences.zh: 这意味着全校采取明确一致的做法，而不只是要求学生在课堂上让设备保持安静。

sentences.text: Some schools already collect phones at the start of the day, keep them in secure storage or use pouches that can be locked.
sentences.zh: 一些学校已在一天开始时收走手机，将其存放在安全地点，或使用可上锁的袋子。

sentences.text: Others do not allow phones on the school site at all, so the announcement describes several existing ways to limit access.
sentences.zh: 另一些学校完全不允许携带手机入校，因此这份公告介绍了几种现有的限制取用方式。

sentences.text: The department says phone access can interrupt lessons and make it harder for pupils to concentrate on their work.
sentences.zh: 教育部表示，能够取用手机可能干扰课堂，让学生更难专心学习。

sentences.text: It also presents the school day as a break from the pressure to spend time online and a chance to meet others face to face.
sentences.zh: 教育部还将上学时间视为远离上网压力的一段休息时间，以及与他人面对面交流的机会。

sentences.text: Clearer guidance is intended to help schools, parents and pupils understand what a phone-free day should involve.
sentences.zh: 更明确的指导旨在帮助学校、家长和学生理解无手机的在校日应包含什么。

sentences.text: At the same time, the government is consulting on technology used for learning in classrooms, including possible independent safety certification.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，政府正就课堂学习所用技术征求意见，其中包括可能实行的独立安全认证。

sentences.text: This is a different question from whether pupils can reach their personal phones during the day.
sentences.zh: 这与学生白天能否取用个人手机是不同的问题。

sentences.text: The consultation explores how educational technology could meet strong safety standards while allowing responsible new ideas to develop.
sentences.zh: 这项意见征集探讨如何让教育技术满足严格的安全标准，同时允许负责任的新想法发展。

sentences.text: These are plans and policy aims, not proof that every school has already changed its rules or that every proposed measure has succeeded.
sentences.zh: 这些是计划和政策目标，并不证明每所学校都已改变规定，也不证明每项拟议措施都已成功。

sentences.note: but对比现有规定和仍可接触手机的实际情况。
while连接两个需要同时兼顾的目标：安全与负责任的创新。

questions.text: Would putting your phone out of reach help you concentrate? Why?
questions.zh: 把手机放到拿不到的地方会帮助你集中注意力吗？为什么？

expressions.text: I find it easier to focus when my phone is out of reach.
expressions.zh: 手机放在拿不到的地方时，我觉得更容易专心。

expressions.text: Learning technology and personal phone use are different issues.
expressions.zh: 学习技术和个人手机使用是不同的问题。
